modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Here is a Little Trick for Kling 4.0.

Link: https://t.co/2sAqIbBkMC

If you're making a music video or even adding a short musical scene to your own movie and want a character dancing to a specific song, here's a little tip for Kling.

Kling won't accept WAV or MP3 music files directly for the omni for this, but there's a simple workaround. Just convert your song into an MP4 video with a black screen and upload that instead. It works great!

***make your own music because MIGHT not work with copyrighted music***

And I just did a VERY simple prompt: Ruth (image1) dancing to the music in (video1).

You can add dances like hip hop dancer, slow dancer, free style and make the person change their dances around.

originalPrompt: Ruth (image1) dancing to the music in (video1).
